articles.summary: Sixth US facility part of over $5 billion First Solar has invested in American manufacturing and RD since 2019 First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) (“First Solar” or “the Company”) today inaugurated the first phase of its new facility in Gaffney, Cherokee County, South Carolina, which onshores final production processes for the Company’s Series 6 Plus modules initiated by the Company’s international fleet. The second phase is forecast to be completed by mid-2027, at which time the approximately $330 million facility is expected to double its annual nameplate capacity to 3.4 gigawatts (GW) and produce the Company’s CuRe technology, while supporting nearly 700 jobs. Approximately 500 of those jobs have already been filled. articles.summary: First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar" or "the Company") will inaugurate the first phase of its new facility in Gaffney, Cherokee County, South Carolina, on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. South Carolina Governor Henry McMaster, US Senator Darline Graham, US Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick, State Senator Harvey Peeler, State Representatives Dennis Moss and Brian Lawson, and Gaffney Mayor Lyman D. Dawkins III are expected to join First Solar Chief Executive Officer Mark Widmar, employees, and community leaders for the ceremony. The approximately $330 million facility onshores final production processes for the Company’s Series 6 Plus modules and currently employs approximately 500 people, a number that is forecast to rise to nearly 700 by mid-2027, when the facility’s second phase is expected to be completed. articles.summary: First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar") today announced it has filed a lawsuit against JA Solar Technology Co., Ltd., JA Solar International, Ltd., JA Solar Vietnam Co., Ltd. and JA Solar Industrial Corp. (collectively, "JA Solar"), together with American Panel Solutions LLC ("AMPS"), alleging infringement of First Solar's US Patent No. 9,130,074 (the "'074 Patent"). articles.summary: Agreement expands First Solar's freedom to operate as it progresses perovskite device development First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar" or "the Company") has signed a non-exclusive patent licensing agreement with CubicPV Inc. ("CubicPV"), granting First Solar access to CubicPV's issued and pending US patents covering perovskite solar technology. The license further clears the path for First Solar to continue its development of photovoltaic (PV) devices built with a perovskite semiconductor for the US utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and residential markets, and applies to sales and distribution of those products domestically. Other terms were not disclosed. First Solar, the largest solar manufacturer in the Western Hemisphere and the world's largest thin film producer, has invested over $2 billion in thin film research and development, including its efforts to advance its perovskite program. articles.title: First Solar, CubicPV Enter into US Patent Licensing Agreement
